description: This PHP class defines a console command for managing SQL database migrations within the Goteo project, integrating LibMigration library with Goteo's configuration and database system.

classes.name: SqlMigrationCommand
classes.description: A console command class that manages SQL migrations, including creating, running, reverting, and installing database schemas using LibMigration.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up the command name, description, options, and help text for the migration command.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Prepares and returns the configuration array for LibMigration based on Goteo settings and CLI options.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the migration commands based on user input, handling different migration operations like status, up, down, create, install, and full migration.
